items.name: Shapechanger
entries: If Lorry isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny rat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, Lorry can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, Lorry can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

enDerived.name: Lorry Wanwillow
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: If Lorry isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny rat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, Lorry can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, Lorry can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Lorry fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
entries: When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, Lorry transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling {@condition unconscious}, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then {@condition paralyzed} until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Lorry regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Lorry takes radiant damage or damage from {@item Holy Water (Flask)|PHB|holy water}, this trait doesn't function at the start of Lorry's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Lorry can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: Lorry has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
items.entry: Lorry can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
items.entry: Lorry takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
items.entry: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Lorry's heart while Lorry is {@condition incapacitated} in its resting place, Lorry is {@condition paralyzed} until the stake is removed.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
items.entry: Lorry takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries: Lorry makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Lorry can grapple the target (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is {@condition grappled} by Lorry, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Lorry regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a {@creature vampire spawn} under Lorry's control.

action.name: Charm
entries: Lorry targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see Lorry, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be {@condition charmed} by Lorry. The {@condition charmed} target regards Lorry as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Lorry's control, it takes Lorry's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for Lorry's bite attack.

Each time Lorry or Lorry's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Lorry is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries: Lorry magically calls {@dice 2d4} swarms of {@creature swarm of bats||bats} or {@creature swarm of rats||rats}, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, Lorry can call {@dice 3d6} {@creature wolf||wolves} instead. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of Lorry and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Lorry dies, or until Lorry dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Lorry moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: Lorry makes one unarmed strike.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Lorry makes one bite attack.
